Trip planning app Tripsy has rolled out an update this week, adding support for iOS 27 extra-large widgets, a brand-new "Smart Import" tool, AI-powered features, and other improvements. Here are the details.

Tripsy update brings AI-powered features

At Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple briefly mentioned the independently developed travel planning app Tripsy while showcasing some of the new Siri AI features in iOS 27. Earlier this week, Apple also issued an iOS 27 press release, highlighting that Siri would soon be able to add restaurant recommendations directly to Tripsy.

The app was also a finalist for the 2024 App Store Awards. It updated to version 3.10 earlier this week, bringing a host of new features, including AI-powered tools and support for iOS 27 capabilities.

New features include the new "Smart Import" function, which can convert links, documents (including PDFs), saved emails, screenshots, accessible Instagram and TikTok posts, and pasted text into locations and booking items within the app.

"Smart Import" also supports importing lists and guides from Google Maps and Apple Maps, allowing users to select the suggested items they actually want to add to their itinerary.

Likewise, this update introduces "Smart Insights," which uses Apple's Foundation Models to analyse attached documents and emails on-device and extract useful itinerary details such as baggage allowance, breakfast, parking, cancellation policies, and fees.

Other improvements in Tripsy 3.10 include:

  • Support for extra-large iPhone widgets in iOS 27, providing a more complete overview of your itinerary.
  • Improved travel stats updates, map stability, and the Mac version's import layout.
  • Improved location suggestions, including access to all hotels in the itinerary and the ability to turn off airport departure suggestions you no longer need.

Tripsy notes that "Smart Import" and "Smart Insights" are Pro subscription features, priced at US$39 per year or US$199 for a lifetime subscription.
